keyLimits.en: For individuals using REAPER personally, and for businesses/organizations with yearly gross revenue not exceeding $20,000 (includes education and non-profit use). Includes free upgrades through version 8.99.
Required for commercial use by organizations with yearly gross revenue exceeding $20,000. Includes free upgrades through version 8.99.

cautions.en: Prices are a one-time perpetual license fee excluding VAT and local taxes; free upgrades are capped at version 8.99, after which a discounted upgrade fee applies for later major versions.

capabilities.en: Full digital audio workstation for recording, editing, mixing and mastering with unlimited tracks.
Highly customizable UI, routing and scripting (ReaScript, JSFX) for building custom workflows.
Extensive native and third-party VST/AU plugin ecosystem support.
Single license key can be used on multiple computers, as long as only one is running at a time.

limitations.en: No permanent free tier; only a 60-day full-featured evaluation before a license is required to keep using it.
Interface is less polished/opinionated out of the box than competitors like Logic Pro or Ableton Live, requiring more manual customization to feel comfortable.

reason.en: Industry-standard DAW covering the same recording/mixing/mastering workflow.
Mac-native DAW competing directly for music production and post-production audio work.
Popular DAW for music production, especially electronic and live performance workflows.
DAW-adjacent audio editing tool used for similar recording and mixing tasks.
Free, simpler multitrack audio editor covering overlapping basic use cases.

unknowns: Actual platform list (Windows/macOS/Linux) not explicitly re-confirmed from the purchase page content fetched in this session.
